label: PowerEdge R760 2U rack server
description: 2U two-socket rack server where the 2x 1GbE LOM card and the OCP 3.0 card are both optional factory items; the dedicated 1GbE iDRAC9 port is always present. Up to eight PCIe Gen5/Gen4 slots, plus an optional DPU management interface card.
notes: Modelled as the common 2x 1GbE LOM build. Dell allows either LOM card, an OCP 3.0 card, or both: OCP 3.0 is the 10/25GbE path and the LOM card is copper only. Up to 8x PCIe slots. Dedicated iDRAC Ethernet port is separate.
